title: A Story page says which concepts it is about
description:
As a search or answer engine, I want a Story page to list the concepts it is about by identifier, so that stories connect to the concept pages.

```gherkin
Feature: Stories name their concepts
  Scenario: A Story tagged with concepts
    Given a published Story tagged with two accepted public concepts
    When the Story page is projected
    Then its structured data lists both concepts by identifier as what the Story is about

  Scenario: A concept without a public page is not named
    Given a Story tagged with a concept of a kind that is never public
    Then the structured data does not mention that concept
```
